name: keycaps-design-system
description: Owned design tokens, React components, and documentation for jflamb.com projects.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @jflamb/keycaps-tokens build && pnpm --filter @jflamb/keycaps-react build && pnpm --filter @jflamb/keycaps-storybook build
scripts.release:dry-run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:package && npm pack --dry-run --json ./packages/tokens && npm pack --dry-run --json ./packages/react
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @jflamb/keycaps-tokens build && pnpm --filter @jflamb/keycaps-react build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:pages && pnpm test:package && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm audit:high
